summary: Iteration 14 end-to-end testing (backend + frontend) covering the 5 requested UX changes: (1) menu reorder + REGISTAR SESSÃO CTA at bottom, (2) DADOS DEMO button removed, (3) per-athlete exclusion dropdown with injured badge on Dashboard, (4) chart zoom controls (buttons, slider, presets), (5) team backup export/import (ZIP with atletas.csv + sessoes.csv). All 6 backend pytest cases pass (baseline team-detailed, exclude_athlete_ids, export ZIP, import merge dedupe, import replace, invalid mode). Frontend Playwright walkthrough validates every data-testid, correct DOM ordering, DADOS DEMO absent, CSV 30D + RESET TOTAL still present, athlete filter opens with 8 rows/checkboxes, TODOS + SEM LESIONADOS quick actions present, unchecking triggers API call with ?exclude_athlete_ids=..., all zoom controls render, export triggers download of backup_Sporting_Futsal_Lisboa_<date>.zip, and player regression (/atleta) still shows Registar + Histórico correctly.

issues: Icon assignments look swapped: data-testid='zoom-out-btn' renders <ZoomIn/> icon and data-testid='zoom-in-btn' renders <ZoomOut/> icon (Dashboard.jsx lines 355/362). Functionally 'zoom-out'=less days, 'zoom-in'=more days works, but users will see the opposite icon. Consider swapping the icons or renaming testids.

action_items: Optional: swap the zoom-in/zoom-out icons on Dashboard chart zoom controls so the icon matches the label/intent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~3560 lines — high time to split into routers (auth, athletes, sessions, analytics, backup, admin). Maintenance risk.
Export/import ZIP has no size limit — a malicious client could POST a very large ZIP. Consider MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE guard.

In import merge mode, dedupe key is (athlete_id, date, session_type) — two legitimate sessions of the same type on the same day (rare but possible: morning + afternoon training) would be dropped. Acceptable but worth documenting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested checks (all testids found, integrations working, download triggered)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing Sporting Futsal Lisboa demo team (8 athletes). test_import_replace_wipes_and_reinserts wipes and re-imports from the just-exported ZIP so the team state is preserved after the run (same athlete ids/sessions restored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 (menu reorder + backup + athlete-filter dropdown + chart zoom) is verified. Test suite /app/backend/tests/test_iteration14.py is idempotent — it exports, then re-imports over the current team (merge → all dupes; replace → wipe & reinsert same rows). Note athlete IDs are preserved across replace because CSV keeps the source id. If you want to re-test just the frontend, no seeding needed.
